name: ts-runtypes-pre-publish-e2e-deps
description: Builder toolchains baked into the shared image for the pre-publish e2e feature matrix. Only these (never-changing) toolchains are baked; each e2e run installs just the changing @mionjs/* from verdaccio ON TOP of this node_modules. next/react are baked for the Turbopack app (Next has no plugin API, so it is driven by a loader + broker instead); @types/react is baked with them because `next build` AUTO-INSTALLS it when a tsx app has no types, and that runs `pnpm add` inside /e2e, which re-resolves and PRUNES the baked toolchains mid-run (the build then hangs, silently); vite is aliased to rolldown-vite (Vite-on-Rolldown, the modern consumer stack build-vite exercises). The assertion tests use node:test (built-in), so no test runner is baked. Versions are exact-pinned to releases older than the 30-day minimumReleaseAge cutoff.
